order=np.argsort(T)
nb=10
for chunk in np.array_split(order,nb):
    t=T[chunk].mean(); e=eps[chunk]; y=sigma[chunk]
    # fit y = c0 + c1 e + c2 log e + c3 exp(-e)  (4 params)
    A=np.c_[np.ones_like(e),e,np.log(e),np.exp(-e)]
    cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)
    r=np.sqrt(np.mean((A@cc-y)**2))
    A2=np.c_[np.ones_like(e),e,e**2,e**3]
    c2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A2,y,rcond=None)
    r2=np.sqrt(np.mean((A2@c2-y)**2))
    print(f"T={t:.3f} n={len(e)} rms4={r:.4f} poly3rms={r2:.4f} coef={np.round(cc,3)} poly={np.round(c2,3)}")
